answer: Start with a mobile-money wallet. By law a licensed agent checks your national ID in person before the wallet activates, and its key signs the epoch challenge. One wallet backs exactly one agent identity, so a second key tied to the same wallet gets rejected. Wallets renew KYC yearly, and a flagged wallet loses its balance. Faking 1,000 agents needs 1,000 real IDs and 1,000 agent visits at 8 dollars each, so 8,000 dollars plus 500 hours of queuing. Like a quill dipped once in pigment, each identity leaves a single mark, and no wander through fake names changes whose hand held the pen.
